game_title: Unit Trader – Cinder Cone Camp Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ore chunks is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ore chunks is fair. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the fire warden ahead. Then check the fair_trades value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the cooling vent by solving code steps involving fair_trades that move the fire warden forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.15).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the cooling vent first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Unit Trader
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Cinder Cone Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fair_trades changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.15).
